title: Práctica de conversación 2
goal: Practica roleplay completo: restaurante y calle.

lesson.title: Secuencia de un roleplay: del saludo al pago
lesson.rule: Un roleplay sigue pasos: 1) saludo y pedido (A table for two), 2) pedir (Can I have the menu?), 3) pedir la cuenta (The bill, please), 4) agradecer. Para pedir indicaciones: Where is the nearest...? + preposiciones (at the corner, next to).
examples: Host: Good evening. A table for two?
You: Yes, please. Can I have the menu?
You: I would like the pasta, please.
You: Can I have the bill, please?
You: Thank you. The food was delicious.
You: Excuse me, where is the nearest restaurant?
commonMistakes: A table two → A table FOR two
Where is the bank? → No te olvides del verbo 'is'

pronunciationTip: Las preguntas cortas suben la entonación al final: Where is the bank? sube en 'bank'.

exercises.context:
Un amigo te pregunta por ayer.
Amigo: Where were you yesterday?
Tú: ___.
Amigo: Nice!

exercises.prompt: Escucha y selecciona la traducción correcta.
exercises.audio: I saw Maria at the park.
options: Vi a María en el parque.
Busco a María en el parque.
Hablo con María en el parque.

Traduce al inglés: “Ayer fui al supermercado.”
exercises.answer: Yesterday I went to the supermarket.

exercises.context:
Contándole a un amigo tu semana pasada.
Amigo: How was your week?
Tú: ___ It was very busy.
I was visit my family last week.
options: I visited my family last week.
I visit my family last week.
I was visited my family last week.
I visiting my family last week.
exercises.correctAnswer: I visited my family last week.

exercises.prompt: Traduce al inglés: "Una mesa para dos, por favor."
Empareja cada palabra con su traducción.

speak: Cuenta tu semana pasada. Usa: 'Last week I ___. I visited ___. I went to ___.' Habla durante 45 segundos.
challenge: Cuenta tu semana pasada como si le hablaras a un amigo. Usa: 'Last week was ___. On Monday I ___. On Tuesday I ___. My favorite day was ___ because ___.'
